# Chimpbase

> Backend actions, queues and schedules in one TypeScript runtime. SQLite or memory for local development; PostgreSQL for shared application and coordination state.

## Start here

- [Getting Started](https://github.com/chimpbase/chimpbase/blob/main/docs/getting-started.md): Complete Bun notes API with actions, routes and collections; start with `bunx chimpbase dev`.
- [Configuration](https://github.com/chimpbase/chimpbase/blob/main/docs/configuration.md): Storage, environment variables, host imports and CLI commands.
- [README](https://github.com/chimpbase/chimpbase/blob/main/README.md): Repository overview and contributor commands.

## Main guides

- [Actions](https://github.com/chimpbase/chimpbase/blob/main/docs/actions.md): Validated, transactional business operations.
- [HTTP routes](https://github.com/chimpbase/chimpbase/blob/main/docs/routes.md): Standard Request/Response handlers.
- [Collections](https://github.com/chimpbase/chimpbase/blob/main/docs/collections.md): JSON document storage without application migrations.
- [Database](https://github.com/chimpbase/chimpbase/blob/main/docs/database.md): SQL, migrations and Kysely.
- [Subscriptions](https://github.com/chimpbase/chimpbase/blob/main/docs/subscriptions.md): Internal event reactions.
- [Workers](https://github.com/chimpbase/chimpbase/blob/main/docs/workers.md): Queues, retries and dead letter handling.
- [Cron](https://github.com/chimpbase/chimpbase/blob/main/docs/cron.md): Recurring jobs.
- [Context](https://github.com/chimpbase/chimpbase/blob/main/docs/context.md): Handler APIs.

## Public package

Install `chimpbase` with Bun, npm or Deno's npm support. All public imports are subpaths of that single package. Scoped repository workspaces are private; do not tell users to install them.

- `chimpbase` and `chimpbase/runtime`: portable runtime DSL and context types.
- `chimpbase/runtime/bun`, `chimpbase/runtime/node`, `chimpbase/runtime/deno`: explicit host adapters. Portable imports do not select a host.
- `chimpbase/core`, `chimpbase/host`, `chimpbase/postgres`, `chimpbase/tooling`: low-level integration and tooling.
- `chimpbase/auth`, `chimpbase/blobs`, `chimpbase/mesh`, `chimpbase/otel`, `chimpbase/pact`, `chimpbase/rest-collections`, `chimpbase/webhooks`: optional integrations.

Published consumers receive compiled JavaScript and TypeScript declarations. The [root manifest](https://github.com/chimpbase/chimpbase/blob/main/package.json) is authoritative for public exports and binaries.

## Advanced guides

- [Advanced overview](https://github.com/chimpbase/chimpbase/blob/main/docs/advanced/index.md): Optional workflows, modules, framework integrations, plugins and deployment.
- [App composition](https://github.com/chimpbase/chimpbase/blob/main/docs/advanced/app-composition.md): Imported registrations, stable action names and custom entry points.
- [Workflows](https://github.com/chimpbase/chimpbase/blob/main/docs/advanced/workflows.md): Durable processes and contract tooling.
- [Modules](https://github.com/chimpbase/chimpbase/blob/main/docs/advanced/modules.md): Business boundaries and public interfaces.
- [Plugins](https://github.com/chimpbase/chimpbase/blob/main/docs/advanced/plugins.md): Plugin composition.
- [Storage adapters](https://github.com/chimpbase/chimpbase/blob/main/docs/advanced/storage-adapters.md): Low-level engine contracts.
- [Event delivery](https://github.com/chimpbase/chimpbase/blob/main/docs/advanced/event-bus.md): Event transports and coordination.
- [Deployment](https://github.com/chimpbase/chimpbase/blob/main/docs/advanced/deployment.md): Self-hosted production setup.

## Repository examples and source

Start with [Bun basic](https://github.com/chimpbase/chimpbase/tree/main/examples/bun/basic), [Node basic](https://github.com/chimpbase/chimpbase/tree/main/examples/node/basic), or [Deno basic](https://github.com/chimpbase/chimpbase/tree/main/examples/deno/basic). Intermediate and advanced examples remain separate under each host directory.

- [Runtime exports](https://github.com/chimpbase/chimpbase/blob/main/packages/runtime/index.ts): Authoritative application API.
- [Shared host](https://github.com/chimpbase/chimpbase/blob/main/packages/host/src/library.ts): Host options, app loading and startup.
- [CLI source](https://github.com/chimpbase/chimpbase/blob/main/packages/tooling/src/cli.ts): Supported commands and flags.
- [Tests](https://github.com/chimpbase/chimpbase/tree/main/tests): Runtime regression coverage.

Install workspace dependencies once at the repository root with `bun install`. Repository examples may import private workspace aliases for source development; those aliases are not public installation instructions.
